prompt: We are getting login redirect loops and images are broken after migrating Wiki.js to a new HTTPS domain behind nginx.
expected: Agent loads references/troubleshooting.md (or Critical initial config), identifies Site URL scheme/host mismatch, and proposes setting Site URL to the public https URL while leaving TLS termination at the reverse proxy.
actual: Agent loaded references/troubleshooting.md, called out HTTPS/HTTP Site URL mismatch after the domain move, and recommended updating Site URL to the public https host with TLS kept on nginx.
